# Seconda — AI Mock Interview System

> Seconda is an AI-powered mock interview system engineered for deep, resume-grounded practice, adaptive multi-round follow-ups, and deterministic 6-dimension evaluation.

## Core Overview
Seconda moves beyond superficial, template-based Q&A. It analyzes candidate resumes (PDF or structured facts), extracts real experience and architectural choices, generates grounded interview questions, probes answers with an autonomous Agent, and scores performance across 6 distinct dimensions.

## Key Capabilities
- **Resume Fact Grounding**: 100% anchored on real projects, technical stacks, and metrics extracted from the candidate's resume.
- **Adaptive Multi-Round Probing**: Autonomous Agent identifies gaps, ambiguities, and trade-offs in candidate answers to ask targeted follow-up questions.
- **6-Dimension Scoring Model**: Deterministic evaluation (0–10 per question, 0–100 overall score) on Understanding, Expression, Logic, Depth, Authenticity, and Reflection.
- **Coach Mode & Deep Dive**: Actionable step-by-step feedback, model answer structures (STAR framework), and common pitfall analysis.
- **Flexible Persona & Focus**: Configurable interviewer styles (Friendly, Standard, Stressful) and focus areas (Project Deep Dive, Technical Foundations, Behavioral Evidence).

- Software engineers, architects, and technical leaders preparing for top-tier tech interviews.
- Job seekers wanting realistic, high-pressure practice with objective quantitative feedback.
